[中文](#cn-v0.2.1-rc.3-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.1-rc.3-community)

体验优化

- 新增左侧栏、会话视图和右侧栏的「更多」菜单，方便浏览和创建插件。 @Yifffan, @imccyu - 修复切换会话后，点击「新会话」找不回未发送草稿的问题。 @imccyu ### 其他变更 - DeepSeek API Key 适配器的模型列表更新方式与账号登录模式保持一致。 @LegGasai

Improvements

- Add More menus to the left sidebar, conversation views, and right sidebar for browsing and creating plugins. by @Yifffan, @imccyu - Fix New Session losing an unsent draft after switching sessions. by @imccyu ### Chores - The DeepSeek API key adapter now updates its model list the same way as account sign-in. by @LegGasai Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3)
